'**Amp 1**' - the whole printed text. Lightning Instant (Rosetta).

AMP MUST BE AUTHORED, unlike Boost/Dominate-class printed keywords - a deliberate deviation from the keywords-only-text-means-empty-abilities rule, verified before deviating: the card DB carries keywords:['Amp'] for this slug, but nothing engine-side consumes it. Census read this session: build_keyword_triggers (triggers/triggers.py) imports amp at line 63 and has NO case that dispatches it (the single grep match is the import); card_keywords.py and registry.py KEYWORD_STATIC_ABILITIES have no amp handling at all. An empty stub would load clean and do nothing. The primitive exists (effect_keywords.amp, CR 8.5.47: the next time an event the player controls would deal arcane damage this turn, it deals that much plus N; stored in class_counters['amp'] and consumed by the arcane-damage path) but reaches the engine only through the DSL AMP effect type.

ABILITY TYPE PLAY, not INSTANT: per DSL_REFERENCE, INSTANT means an ACTIVATED ability with instant timing ('Instant - {t}: ...'); an Instant CARD whose effect happens when you play it is ability_type PLAY. High Voltage is played from hand for its effect. Shipped precedent with identical shape: ros/exploding_aether_blue.json (PLAY + AMP amount 1; also omn/arc_ramp_red.json, lgs/volzar_the_lightning_rod.json).

HANDLER READ THIS SESSION: AMP (effect_types.py:1894-1899) reads 'amount' and routes effect_amp -> canonical amp(); default is 1, authored explicitly anyway. CR 8.5.47 makes the bonus turn-scoped inside the primitive itself, so no span/duration plumbing is needed or read.

No gaps; the single clause is expressible.
